Plate ~26 cm. There's a roasted chicken leg quarter (drumstick plus part of the thigh), about 150 g with bone, roughly 110 g edible. Next to it is a whole wing, about 50 g with bone, roughly 30 g edible. Counting all visible food including bone, the total is about 200 g. For energy, the edible meat with skin comes to about 140 g at roughly 2.3 kcal/g, giving about 320 kcal.
